LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_BudgetRule: Each pulse shares one condition budget equally among the damaged targets assigned to this source, so more targets mend more slowly. Fractional HP carries between pulses. Only the strongest covering Ferrite source repairs a target; overlap adds no repair. Works during combat.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_MendsSelfDesc: While worn or wielded, mends this item and the wearer's worn apparel and equipped weapons, including tainted apparel without removing the taint. Needs no Solar energy.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_LooseItemsDesc: Mends non-rotting items on the ground, in stockpiles and on shelves.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_ColonistGearDesc: Mends the worn apparel and equipped weapons of colonists, slaves and prisoners, keeping corpse-apparel taint. Enemy gear is never repaired.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_SolarPerHpDesc: Paid for each hit point restored to an item.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_BudgetDesc: A share of each target's maximum hit points.
LanguageData.Lumen_Ferrite_SolarPerHpSetting: Solar energy per HP of item or gear repaired
